_comment: Curated cells for docs/capability-matrix.md (BL-068). This file is COMMITTED; the
section files in docs/.sections/ are gitignored scratch that the section agents
rewrite on every regen. scripts/assemble_matrix.py merges these over the generated
cells BEFORE counting, so the emitted tables and the derived block still agree.
agents  row key = agent file name, or 'file.exs::Label' when one file
contributes several rows to a section; fields: label, tools
scripts row key = script file name; field: purpose
An override matching no row FAILS the run (exit 1) — a renamed script must not
silently drop its curation, which is the failure this file exists to prevent.

generate_pdf.py.purpose: Render document spec to PDF in structured or narrative mode with optional Markdown template support. Jinja2 path added in m6 (`has_jinja: true`).

render_template.py.purpose: Render Markdown narrative template with variable substitution and sheet table partials into HTML. Optional fields render as empty string when absent (m5). (Deprecated in m6 — use `generate_html.py` for new doc types; kept for backward compatibility.)

generate_html.py.purpose: Render a Jinja2 `.html.j2` template with a context dict to HTML; absent vars render empty (`jinja2.Undefined`), autoescaping on. Replaces `render_template.py` for new doc types (m6).

generate_docx_from_html.py.purpose: Convert an HTML file to DOCX via Pandoc using a Bitloka reference doc (`reference.docx`) for branding and styles (m6).

run_log_writer.py.purpose: Append a run entry (tenant, doc_type, run_id, timestamp, context, outputs) to the run log; idempotent by run_id (m3).

resolve_last_run.py.purpose: Resolve "same as last month" from the run log: bump date to month-end and increment the invoice number with FY-rolling sequence (m3).

chain_docbuilder.py.purpose: Chain context_builder → orchestrator as two sequential top-level mix runs; emits the orchestrator protocol (rig-p9 — the Rig Docbuilder panel entry point).

validate_fields.py.purpose: Validate and normalise a raw extracted-field JSON against the context schema; exits 1 with a structured error payload if required fields are missing or values are malformed (m4).

_table_html.py.purpose: Shared helper: HTML table markup for the PDF renderers (generate_pdf + render_template).

_drive.py.purpose: Shared helper: Google Drive auth, folder navigation, download/upload (fetch_template, list_templates, upload_output).

_format.py.purpose: Shared display formatter for cell values: currency → $1,234.56, number → thousands-separated with no trailing zeros. Used by the text renderers (generate_docx, _table_html).
